witnesses.separates: the cases with $EmptyLineBands from the concept: train0 with (0,12) set to 8, so no column or row is fully empty. The concept fills the band at rows 4-29, cols 8-16 and its channels as in train0; $EmptyLineBands finds no band and returns the input.

the cases with $WidestBand from the concept: train0 with rows 9-18, cols 17-29 cleared, so the channel to the right is 10 rows wide and the band is 9 columns wide. The concept keeps the vertical band (area 234) and fills rows 5-8, cols 9-15; $WidestBand takes rows 9-18, cols 8-29 as the band, and rows 5-8 of the vertical part reach no grid edge, so they stay background. $EmptyLineBands is undefined, because its open quorum values find different bands.

the cases with $ChannelChain from the concept: the test input with rows 5-7, cols 0-9 cleared, so a channel runs from the left edge to the green of the vertical channel at cols 11-12. The concept leaves row 6 background, because the line does not reach the band's green; $ChannelChain fills row 6, cols 0-10. $EmptyLineBands is undefined, because its open quorum values give different grids.

the cases with $ChannelRect from the concept: the test input with rows 17-20, cols 19-21 cleared, so the channel at cols 19-21 continues five rows past the band. The concept stops the channel's green at the band; $ChannelRect fills col 20 down to the last row of the channel's empty rectangle but one.

the cases with $BandEdgeMargin from the concept: train1 with the band and its channels filled by a checkerboard of 1 and cols 0-1 cleared, so the largest empty rectangle is cols 0-1, rows 0-29. The concept fills col 0, where the band meets the grid edge; $BandEdgeMargin keeps a margin on both long sides and leaves no green.

the cases with $SideEmpty from the concept: train0 with rows 0-3, cols 0-7 cleared. Those rows are empty on the band's left side above the band's top end. The concept leaves them, because no line there reaches the band's green; $SideEmpty fills rows 0-2, cols 0-15, over the noise in cols 8-15.

the concept's tie: the test input with cols 14-16 cleared, so the vertical band spans cols 10-16 and has the same area, 210, as the horizontal band at rows 9-15. The concept and the cases with $WidestBand, which need one band, are undefined. $TiedBands fills both largest rectangles as bands, $EmptyLineBands takes a band on each axis, and the two give the same grid.

the concept from the generator: train0 with rows 0-6, cols 20-29 cleared, so a second empty region sits in the top-right corner, apart from the band and its channels. The concept leaves it background, and the judged output fills it with the same margin.

the cases with $PerpendicularChannels from the concept: train0 with rows 0-3, cols 9-12 cleared, so a channel runs from the top edge into the band's top end, along the band's axis. The concept fills cols 10-11, rows 0-4; $PerpendicularChannels takes only channels across the band, and leaves them. $EmptyLineBands is undefined, because its open quorum values find different bands.

the concept from the generator, and $WidestBand from $TiedBands: the test input with rows 18-27, cols 15-25 cleared, so a second empty region, 10 by 11, sits apart from the band. Its short side is longer than the band's, so $WidestBand takes it as the band, fills only it, and leaves the horizontal band and its channels background. The concept fills the band and its channels as in the test output and leaves the block background; the judged output also fills the block, less a margin next to noise.

$PerpendicularChannels from the concept where $EmptyLineBands is defined: train0 with rows 0-3, cols 10-13 cleared, so a channel runs from the top edge into the band's top end, along the band's axis, and cols 10-13 are empty lines whose runs agree at every open quorum value. The concept fills cols 11-12, rows 0-4; $PerpendicularChannels leaves them.

$ChannelChain from the concept where $EmptyLineBands is defined: train1 with rows 0-5, cols 20-24 cleared, so a channel runs from the top edge to the green of the channel at row 7. The concept leaves cols 21-23 background; $ChannelChain fills them.
`background=DominantColor` from the stored value: train 0 with 0 and 1 swapped

each held case with the stored background from the same case with the background derived as the most frequent color: train0 with most of the noise field's 0 cells set to 8, keeping the band's empty rectangle, the two channels and one cell around them, so that 8 outnumbers 0. At the stored background the cases find train0's band and channels; the derived background is 8.
